annotations.title: FIC Food Allergen Highlighting & Big 7 Nutrition Table Deterministic Screener

description:
[FIC food allergen highlighting & Big 7 nutrition table deterministic screener. Pure calculation, read-only, side-effect free]. Audits food packaging labels against Regulation (EU) No 1169/2011 (FIC), detecting 14 Annex II allergens, checking font x-height legibility (1.2mm / 0.9mm), and auditing mathematical consistency of the mandatory Big 7 nutrition table.
Usage: Pass product name, ingredient list, declared allergens, and nutrition table values to verify packaging compliance.
Returns: JSON object with { productName: string, mandatoryAllergenAudit: object, nutritionTableAudit: object, legibilityAudit: object, statutoryVerdict: string, nonComplianceFindings: array }.

allergensDistinguishedInIngredients.description: Whether allergens in ingredients list are emphasized through a distinct typeset (Art. 21(1)(b))

declaredAllergens.description: Allergens explicitly highlighted or listed in allergen box

fontXHeightMm.description: Measured x-height of packaging label typography in millimeters

ingredientList.description: Full ingredient text as printed on packaging

nutritionPer100gOrMl.description: Mandatory Big 7 nutrition values per 100g or 100ml

energyKj.description: Energy value in kJ (if omitted, calculated as kcal * 4.184)

packagingLargestSurfaceAreaCm2.description: Surface area of the largest packaging face in cm² (threshold: 80 cm²)
